propositions: BindingStore at 799 lines owns byte persistence, lifecycle policy, recovery, and GET rotation without cohesive separation of concerns, blocking new safety rules and causing production code to mutate inner state returned by shallow all_bindings() query

Extraction must preserve all five-file selective publication behavior, unknown fields, exact JSON serialization format (indent=2, sorted keys, trailing newline), and shallow all_bindings() compatibility through the public facade

Retirement completion requires durable tombstone authority: a live forward/reverse pair is removed only when tombstone, forward, and reverse identities agree, and only explicit unretire revokes that intent—automatic liveness observations never resurrect a tombstoned identity

Live recovery execution must run after exclusive lock/staleness validation but before remote issue fetch and binding walk to prevent upgraded passes from interleaving new liveness evidence with completion

Three internal owners (repository/unit-of-work, lifecycle policy, recovery) are extracted behind one unchanged public BindingStore facade with typed dictionary views preserving unknown fields and exact JSON behavior
Construction, load, check, dry-run, preview, selection, and filtered operations must not perform recovery writes; only validated write-bearing operations repair interrupted retirements
